title: Foam-Agent: A Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Automating Computational Fluid Dynamics Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2505.04997v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has been the main workhorse of computational physics, yet its steep learning curve and fragmented, multi-stage workflow create significant barriers to entry. We present Foam-Agent, a multi-agent framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to automate the end-to-end CFD workflow in OpenFOAM from a single natural-language prompt. Foam-Agent rests on three methodological contributions. First, a multi-index retrieval scheme organizes domain knowledge along four complementary structural dimensions and selects indices by workflow stage, sharpening retrieval precision over conventional single-index retrieval-augmented generation. Second, dependency-aware file generation is formulated as a topological traversal of the OpenFOAM case dependency graph, so that each configuration file is synthesized in the context of its already-generated predecessors, enforcing cross-file consistency. translated_title: Foam-Agent：基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于自动化计算流体力学工作流
translated_abstract: 计算流体力学（CFD）一直是计算物理学的主要工具，但其陡峭的学习曲线和碎片化、多阶段的工作流造成了显著的入门障碍。我们提出了Foam-Agent，一个利用大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体框架，能够从单个自然语言提示自动完成OpenFOAM中的端到端CFD工作流。Foam-Agent基于三个方法论贡献。首先，一种多索引检索方案沿四个互补的结构维度组织领域知识，并根据工作流阶段选择索引，相比传统的单索引检索增强生成，提高了检索精度。其次，依赖感知的文件生成被形式化为对OpenFOAM案例依赖图的拓扑遍历，使每个配置文件在其已生成前序文件的上下文中合成，从而强制跨文件一致性。第三，一个轨迹...
tldr: Foam-Agent通过多索引检索、依赖感知文件生成和轨迹优化，实现了从自然语言提示到OpenFOAM端到端CFD工作流的全自动化，显著降低了CFD入门门槛。
en_tdlr: Foam-Agent automates end-to-end OpenFOAM CFD workflows from natural-language prompts via multi-index retrieval, dependency-aware file generation, and trajectory optimization, significantly lowering the entry barrier for CFD.
